description: Read an instance's configuration (like `clerk config pull`): an object keyed by top-level config key, such as session or auth_email, plus config_version. Sensitive values are redacted.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

keys.description: Top-level config keys to return, such as "session" or "auth_email". Omit to return every key.

name: get_instance_config
title: Get instance configuration
